title: Retail store
summary: Scan stocked goods, choose sizes, apply promotions, and handle returns with manager approval.
videoTitle: RobOS Point of Sale — Retail Checkout and Returns
videoDescription: A recorded test walkthrough of a retail sale: scan a barcode, choose a size, apply SAVE10, record a demo card payment, and process a return with a manager PIN.

steps.title: Start with the retail sample
actions: On first launch choose Retail store. The example shop is Main Street General Store.
Sign in with the sample cashier PIN 3333. These PINs and products are demonstration data; replace them before real use.

steps.title: Scan an item and choose a size
actions: On Register, scan the barcode on a Classic Tee White in size M. A keyboard-style scanner types the code and presses Enter.
Tap Slim Jeans, choose size 32, then Add to order. Check the item names and sizes in the ticket.

steps.title: Apply a promotion and review the total
actions: Open the discount controls, enter SAVE10 and apply it. The sample gives 10% off the order.
Check the discount, item tax and amount due before pressing Pay. Your own catalog and tax settings determine live totals.

steps.title: Record payment and review the receipt
actions: The video uses the sample test card provider, which does not move money. Select Card and complete the demo payment.
For live trading, configure your supported card workflow first. A standalone terminal payment is processed on that terminal, then its approval reference is recorded in the register.
Check the receipt and return to a new order. Paid stocked items reduce inventory.

steps.title: Handle a return with a manager
actions: Open Orders and select the sale. Open the refund controls, choose the returned quantity and enter a reason.
A cashier needs manager approval. Enter the sample manager PIN 2222 in the approval dialog.
Confirm the refund result and check the stock quantity. In the video the test provider handles the refund; verify your live provider's behavior before accepting returns.

steps.title: Continue with stock and self-checkout
actions: Use Inventory to receive a delivery or count the shelf. Counts require a reason.
Use Menu & Catalog to edit products and variants, then review Reports for recorded sales.
The shared guide below covers shopper self-checkout, camera scanning and counting the cash drawer.
steps.caption: Related workflow: receiving and counting retail inventory.

title: Coffee shop
summary: Customize drinks, take cash with change due, and move paid orders through the barista queue to collection.
videoTitle: RobOS Point of Sale — Coffee Order, Cash and Prep
videoDescription: A recorded test walkthrough of a coffee order: open the drawer, customize a latte, add a tip, record cash and change, then prepare the drink and record collection.
highlights: Required drink choices and priced extras

steps.title: Start the coffee shop and open the drawer
actions: Choose Coffee shop on first launch. The example menu belongs to Bean There Coffee.
Sign in with sample cashier PIN 3333. Open Cash, enter a starting float of 100 using the keypad, then press Open drawer.
The recording uses sample data and simulated cash entries; it does not process real transactions.

steps.title: Build a custom latte
actions: Return to Register and tap Latte. Required option groups must be completed before the item can be added.
Choose Medium, Oat milk and Extra shot, then Add to order. Check that the modifiers and their prices appear on the ticket.

steps.title: Add a tip and take cash
actions: Open the tip controls and choose 20% for this example. Review the total, then press Pay.
Tap the $20 quick-tender button. Check the displayed change and record the cash payment.
Read the receipt before starting the next order. Cash rounding and quick-tender amounts can be configured by a manager.

steps.title: Prepare the paid order
actions: Open Prep. The paid latte appears at the barista station.
Start preparation, then mark the ticket Ready when the drink is finished.
The customer-ready display at /ready shows order numbers. It is a separate customer-facing page.

steps.title: Record collection
actions: Hand the order to the customer and mark it Picked up on the prep ticket.
Check that the ticket leaves the active queue. This closes the preparation work; payment was recorded earlier.

steps.title: Offer customer self-ordering
actions: Open /kiosk on a customer-facing device to show the sample menu.
Customers choose their drink options and can take an order number to pay at the counter when that option is enabled.
Unattended card payments require a real integrated provider. The sample card gateway is for demonstration only.
steps.caption: Related workflow: a customer reviews a self-ordering kiosk order.

title: Bar
summary: Keep named tabs open, send rounds to prep stations, record an ID check, and close the tab with a tip.
videoTitle: RobOS Point of Sale — Bar Tabs, Rounds and Checkout
videoDescription: A recorded test walkthrough of a bar tab: open a named tab, send drinks and food to prep, recall it for another round, record the staff ID check, add a tip, and close with a demo card payment.
highlights: Separate bar and kitchen prep queues
Recorded ID checks, tips and split payments

steps.title: Start the bar sample
actions: Choose Bar on first launch. The example venue is The Rusty Anchor.
Sign in with sample cashier PIN 3333. The recording uses demo products and a test card provider; no real payment is taken.

steps.title: Open a named tab
actions: Select the tab order type on Register. Add a Hazy IPA and choose Pint.
Enter the tab name Dana and open the tab. Add Pretzel Bites to the same ticket.

steps.title: Send the round and hold the tab
actions: Press Send to send the current items to their preparation stations, then Hold the tab.
Open Prep and select the bar station. Drinks appear there; food is routed to the kitchen.
Tabs keeps the unpaid ticket available while staff work on other orders.

steps.title: Recall the tab for another round
actions: Open Tabs, select Dana's tab and check the existing items.
Add another pint and press Send. Only the newly added items are sent for preparation.

steps.title: Record the ID check and add a tip
actions: The sample blocks payment for age-restricted items until staff record an ID check. The video demonstrates that guard.
After checking the customer's ID yourself, record ID checked in the register. This records a staff action; the app does not verify identity.
Open the tip controls and choose 20% for the example, then review the final amount.

steps.title: Close the tab and review the receipt
actions: Press Pay and select Card for the recorded demonstration. The test provider approves the sample transaction without charging anyone.
Read the closed-tab receipt, including the tip and item tax lines. For a live venue, configure your real payment workflow before use.
The shared guide explains splitting payments, manager-approved comps, and closing the cash drawer.
